detached_structure.evidence: A fenced deck or patio area attaches to the east side of the house, but it appears connected to the main structure rather than a separate building.

signals.notes: The central house is heavily shaded by mature canopy, with a dark gray roof that is partly obscured. It has a railed deck or patio with an umbrella table on the east side and a driveway to the northwest holding what looks like a dark vehicle.
